[P2] Return to design before changing the public API

Rule 3 requires a design note for a public API change. This introduces `ComputeError` alongside a namespace migration, but the description documents the selected implementation without evaluating alternatives, including simplification of the existing structure, or linking a maintainer-agreed design note. That leaves the new hierarchy and compatibility policy without the required design review. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and obtain agreement on the options and chosen approach before further implementation.
